title: NFLPA says field in Brazil still needs repairs before Week 3 Cowboys-Ravens Rio game, citing traction and stability issues

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: NFLPA says field in Brazil still needs repairs before Week 3 Cowboys-Ravens Rio game, citing traction and stability issues
sources.description: Experts from the NFL and NFLPA recommended the field at Rio de Janeiro's Maracanã Stadium needs to be reinforced to provide better stability for players.
